q.en: Which verb suits a dramatic, sudden increase?
q.bn: কোন verb একটা dramatic, sudden increase বোঝানোর জন্য ঠিক?

why.en: "Rocketed" signals a much sharper, more dramatic increase than the moderate "rose".
why.bn: "Rocketed" moderate "rose"-এর চেয়ে অনেক বেশি sharp, dramatic increase বোঝায়।

q.en: Fix: "Sales increased by 500 units." (500 is the final total, not the size of the change)
q.bn: ঠিক করো: "Sales increased by 500 units." (৫০০ হলো final total, change-এর size না)

why.en: "To" marks the end point/final total; "by" marks the size of the change.
why.bn: "To" end point/final total বোঝায়; "by" change-এর size বোঝায়।

q.en: Where does the overview go in a Task 1 response?

options.en: At the very end, as a conclusion
Right after the paraphrased introduction, before the body paragraphs
options.bn: Paraphrased introduction-এর ঠিক পরে, body paragraph-এর আগে

options.en: In the middle of body paragraph 1

why.en: The overview comes right after the introduction, before any detailed data, and is heavily weighted for Task Achievement.
why.bn: Overview introduction-এর ঠিক পরে আসে, detailed data-র আগে, এবং Task Achievement-এ এটার ওজন বেশি।

q.en: Should the overview include specific numbers from the graph?
q.bn: Overview-তে graph-এর specific number থাকা উচিত?

options.en: No — it summarises the biggest-picture features; numbers belong in the body
options.bn: না — এটা বড় picture-এর feature summarize করে; number body paragraph-এ থাকে

why.en: The overview covers the 2-3 most significant features without specific figures; detailed numbers go in the body paragraphs.
why.bn: Overview specific figure ছাড়া ২-৩টা সবচেয়ে significant feature কভার করে; detailed number body paragraph-এ যায়।

why.en: Never stack two degree adverbs together — pick the one that accurately matches the size of the change (here, small, so "slightly").
why.bn: দুটো degree adverb একসাথে বসানো যায় না — যেটা change-এর size-এর সাথে ঠিক মেলে সেটাই বাছতে হবে (এখানে ছোট change, তাই "slightly")।
